## 2025 Version

- **Release date:** April, 2025
- **Version:** v1

### Citing this version (V2025.1)

> Cachanosky, Nicolas, João Pedro Bastos, and Alexandre Padilla. 2026.
> "Latin American Left-Leaning Populism Index, V2025.1." Harvard Dataverse.
> https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/KEJ9VF.

**DOI:** [10.7910/DVN/KEJ9VF](https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/KEJ9VF)

See the [Citation page](/pages/citation.html) for BibTeX and how to cite
the code/repository specifically.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# Pulled live from the published index -- see index.qmd for why this
# matters (the old site's "21 countries, 2002-2019" text had gone
# stale relative to the actual data).
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv("data/2025/output/index_2025.csv")

# Countries with a complete POP score at least once, not just any data
# at all. 3 countries (Cuba, Guyana, Suriname) appear in this file with
# partial data (some combination of EP, IP, or POP_R) but never a
# complete POP for any year, so they're excluded from this count --
# matching COUNTRY_SLUGS in _site_helpers.py, which is why exactly
# these countries get a page under /pages/countries/.
n_countries = df[df["POP"].notna()]["ISO3"].nunique()
year_min, year_max = df["YEAR"].min(), df["YEAR"].max()

print(f"- **Countries covered:** {n_countries}")
print(f"- **Years covered:** {year_min}-{year_max}")
```

### Missing observations

A blank cell means no `POP`, `PIP`, `PEP`, or `POP_R` value is available for
that country-year. A common reason is missing `POP_R` data for "independent"
presidents not affiliated with a political party covered by V-Party.

- <a id="dl-missing" href="/data/2025/output/missing_data_2025.xlsx">Download missing-observations report (.xlsx)</a> <span class="dl-count" data-file="missing_data_2025.xlsx"></span>

<script>
// Live download counter (Netlify Blobs-backed, see
// netlify/functions/download-count.js). Deliberately separate from
// Google Analytics -- GA4 already tracks .csv/.xlsx downloads
// automatically and this adds .dta/.bib tracking below, but GA data
// isn't queryable live from a static page without much heavier
// infrastructure, so this exists specifically to power the number
// actually shown here.
(function () {
  var API = "/.netlify/functions/download-count";

  // Populate counts on page load.
  fetch(API)
    .then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
    .then(function (counts) {
      document.querySelectorAll(".dl-count").forEach(function (el) {
        var file = el.getAttribute("data-file");
        var n = counts[file] || 0;
        el.textContent = "(" + n.toLocaleString() + (n === 1 ? " download" : " downloads") + ")";
      });
    })
    .catch(function () {
      // Fail silently -- a missing count shouldn't break the download links themselves.
    });

  // Increment on click, without blocking the actual download.
  // sendBeacon is used specifically because it's designed to survive
  // the page navigating away immediately after the click, unlike a
  // plain fetch() call which isn't guaranteed to complete.
  document.querySelectorAll("a[id^='dl-']").forEach(function (link) {
    link.addEventListener("click", function () {
      var span = link.parentElement.querySelector(".dl-count");
      var file = span ? span.getAttribute("data-file") : null;
      if (!file) return;
      var payload = new Blob([JSON.stringify({ file: file })], { type: "application/json" });
      navigator.sendBeacon(API, payload);
    });
  });
})();
</script>

### Open source

LALLPI is an open-source project. Every step of the index -- from the raw
V-Party, V-Dem, Heritage, and EFW source data through to the published
`index_2025.csv` -- is implemented in publicly available code, not a black
box. This is available so that anyone can:

- **Verify the calculation.** Every formula described on the
  [Documentation](/pages/documentation.qmd) page is implemented exactly as
  written in the pipeline scripts -- step through the code and confirm the
  published numbers directly, rather than taking the methodology
  description on faith.
- **Reuse or adapt it.** Fork the repository, extend it to new countries or
  years, or build your own index on the same pipeline structure.

[View on GitHub](https://github.com/ncachanosky/LALLPI){.btn .btn-primary role="button"}
